title: Border security first. But first before what?
kicker: Immigration · the 2013 Gang of Eight bill
dek: Words on the Senate floor and every roll call Marco Rubio cast on S. 744.

key_votes.text: on a motion to table an amendment that would have blocked provisional status until six months of effective border control.
on the Thune amendment, which placed fencing requirements before provisional status.
on the Vitter amendment, which required a fully operating entry-exit system before any legal status.

statements.quote: Nobody is talking here about preventing legalization. Legalization will take place... Legalization is not conditional.
must happen before those in the country illegally can apply for permanent status
statements.highlight: must happen before those in the country illegally can apply for permanent status

statements.quote: they cannot even apply for permanent status until the fence is built, the Border Patrol agents are hired, and the border security technology, E-Verify, and the tracking system are fully in place
We cannot deal with all three of these problems in one massive piece of legislation. I learned that. We tried it that way.
When I'm president it will not be dealt with the way it was done in the Senate. It will be done first and foremost by bringing illegal immigration under control
statements.highlight: not be dealt with the way it was done in the Senate
